summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Polypoetes son of Peirithous, the Lapith ally of the Achaeans at Troy in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Polypoetes among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Nicomachus and before Ceraus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
